op=r"""\paragraph{\field{SessionStart}} (\fpath{session\_start.go}:69,194;
DES-078 \S2.1.1 and \S2.5). The hook reports a \field{source}; the code as it
stands reads none, and for every source calls \field{createSessionRoster},
which is \field{CreateInCheckout}: it builds a new roster and writes it over
any existing one (\fpath{session/store.go}:58--94). The design replaces that
call for the \field{fork} source only. \field{LcSessionStart} is the hook for
every source. With \field{fixSessionStart} every source goes through
\field{Ensure}, create-if-absent and without \field{--touch}: for a session
that has a roster it changes nothing, and for one that has not it registers
it as \field{LcEnsureCreate} does. The fork source supplies the parent of the
payload; every other source supplies the parent \field{Store.ParentOf}
already records (empty if none), which is what \field{Ensure}'s write-once
rule requires of a caller that is not creating lineage. Without the switch the
sources other than \field{fork} take the replacing path: the roster is
rewritten with the lineage a fresh \field{create} has, which is none, over a
sidecar that records one (\field{sealed} becomes empty while
\field{parentSide} is not). A resumed or compacted fork is the case. For
\field{srcCompact} the roster's kind is that of the roster being replaced,
since a compaction does not change the process. The replacing create of the
CLI, \field{LcCreateCli}, refuses an id whose sidecar records a parent and is
unchanged.

\begin{schema}{LcSessionStart}
\Delta Lifecycle \\
\Xi LcTime \\
\Xi LcSeen \\
\Xi LcClaim \\
\Xi LcBinding \\
\Xi LcPending \\
\Xi LcFlight \\
\Xi LcUsed \\
\Xi LcSkeleton \\
\Xi LcOpen \\
\Xi LcVerdict \\
\Xi LcMission \\
\Xi LcPurged \\
\Xi LcLeak \\
s? : SESSIONID \\
src? : SRC \\
par? : \power SESSIONID \\
gone? : ZBOOL \\
k? : RKIND
\where
\# par? \leq 1 \\
gone? = ztrue \implies par? \neq \emptyset \\
src? \neq srcFork \implies par? = parentSide \limg \{s?\} \rimg \\
(src? = srcCompact \land s? \in roster) \implies k? = rkind(s?) \\
(fixSessionStart = ztrue \lor src? = srcFork) \implies ((s? \in roster \implies (par? = parentSide \limg \{s?\} \rimg \land roster' = roster \land rkind' = rkind \land started' = started \land corrupt' = corrupt \land parentSide' = parentSide \land sealed' = sealed)) \land (s? \notin roster \implies ((parentSide \limg \{s?\} \rimg \neq \emptyset \implies par? = parentSide \limg \{s?\} \rimg) \land (parentSide \limg \{s?\} \rimg = \emptyset \implies (par? \subseteq roster \lor gone? = ztrue)) \land ((fixCycleCheck = ztrue \land parentSide \limg \{s?\} \rimg = \emptyset) \implies s? \notin (par? \cup ((parentSide \plus) \limg par? \rimg))) \land roster' = roster \cup \{ s? \} \land rkind' = rkind \oplus \{ s? \mapsto k? \} \land started' = started \oplus \{ s? \mapsto now \} \land corrupt' = corrupt \land parentSide' = parentSide \cup (\{ s? \} \cross par?) \land sealed' = sealed \oplus \{ s? \mapsto par? \}))) \\
(fixSessionStart = zfalse \land src? \neq srcFork) \implies (roster' = roster \cup \{ s? \} \land rkind' = rkind \oplus \{ s? \mapsto k? \} \land started' = started \oplus \{ s? \mapsto now \} \land corrupt' = corrupt \setminus \{ s? \} \land parentSide' = parentSide \land sealed' = sealed \oplus \{ s? \mapsto \emptyset \})
\end{schema}

"""

    "\\begin{schema}{LcVerdict}\ndAbort : \\power DELEGATIONID \\\\\noverwritten : \\power DELEGATIONID\n\\end{schema}\n\n\\begin{schema}{LcSweep}\ntodo : \\power DELEGATIONID\n\\end{schema}")

    if line=='\\Delta Lifecycle \\\\' and cur not in ('LcCloseUnlocked',):
        out.append('\\Xi LcSweep \\\\')
s='\n'.join(out)

OW=r"overwritten' = overwritten \cup \{ d : skel \setminus dOpen | (d \in dAbort \iff d \notin dAbort') @ d \}"
for name in ['LcDeleteSession','LcPurgeSession','LcCfRefuse','LcCfReconcileClaimed','LcCfReconcileReuse','LcCfReconcileFresh','LcCfAbort','LcReleaseClaim']:
    i=s.index(r"\begin{schema}{%s}"%name); j=s.index(r"\end{schema}",i)

\Delta Lifecycle \\
\Xi LcTime \\
\Xi LcRoster \\
\Xi LcKind \\
\Xi LcStarted \\

\Xi LcLineage \\

\Xi LcVerdict \\
m? : MISSIONID
\where
m? \in missOpen \\
missOpen' = missOpen \setminus \{ m? \} \\
todo' = todo \cup \{ d : dOpen | (d \mapsto m?) \in dMis @ d \}
\end{schema}

""")+hdr('LcSweepWrite',r"""\Xi LcMission \\

\where

todo' = todo \setminus \{ d? \} \\
dOpen' = dOpen \setminus \{ d? \} \\

Lifecycle

import re
P='<repo>/docs/spec-opencode-lifecycle.tex'
s=open(P).read()
def sub(old,new,count=1):
    global s
    assert s.count(old)==count,(s.count(old),old[:70])
    s=s.replace(old,new)
def block(name):
    i=s.index(r"\begin{schema}{%s}"%name); j=s.index(r"\end{schema}",i)
    return i,j
def addline(name,line):
    global s
    i,j=block(name)
    s=s[:j].rstrip('\n')+" \\\\\n"+line+"\n"+s[j:]
def replace_in(name,old,new):
    global s
    i,j=block(name); b=s[i:j]
    assert b.count(old)==1,(name,old)
    s=s[:i]+b.replace(old,new)+s[j:]
sub("fixCas, assumeNoTierBOverFork : ZBOOL","fixCas, fixReuseLocks, assumeNoTierBOverFork : ZBOOL")
sub("fixCas = ztrue \\\\\nassumeNo","fixCas = ztrue \\\\\nfixReuseLocks = ztrue \\\\\nassumeNo")
sub("cfW : SESSIONID \\pfun SESSIONID\n\\end{schema}","cfW : SESSIONID \\pfun SESSIONID \\\\\ncfH : \\power SESSIONID\n\\end{schema}")
sub("leaked : \\power SESSIONID\n\\end{schema}","leaked : \\power SESSIONID \\\\\nunlocked : \\power SESSIONID\n\\end{schema}")
sub("cfW' = \\emptyset \\\\\n","cfW' = \\emptyset \\\\\ncfH' = \\emptyset \\\\\n",count=3)
sub("leaked' = \\emptyset\n\\end{schema}","leaked' = \\emptyset \\\\\nunlocked' = \\emptyset\n\\end{schema}",count=3)
# --- flight updates
for n in ['LcCfBegin','LcCfReconcileClaimed','LcCfExitNoRetry','LcCfFinish','LcCfCrash','LcCfAbort']:
    addline(n,r"cfH' = cfH \setminus \{ c? \}")

# ghost 'unlocked' : ops that Δ leaked set it unchanged; WriteBinding/Claim set it
for n in ['LcCfRefuse','LcCfReconcileClaimed','LcCfExitNoRetry','LcCfFinish']:
    addline(n,r"unlocked' = unlocked")
for n in ['LcCfWriteBinding','LcCfWriteClaim']:
    replace_in(n,"\\Xi LcLeak \\\\\n","")
    addline(n,r"leaked' = leaked \\"+"\n"+r"unlocked' = unlocked \cup (\{ c? \} \setminus cfH)")

replace_in('LcCfAlloc',r"(c? \mapsto 1) \in stage \\",r"(c? \mapsto 1) \in stage \\"+"\n"+r"c? \notin \dom cfD \\")
replace_in('LcCfExitNoRetry',r"used = DELEGATIONID \lor cfM(c?) \notin missOpen",r"(c? \notin \dom cfD \land used = DELEGATIONID) \lor cfM(c?) \notin missOpen")

replace_in('LcCfReconcileReuse',r"""(c? \mapsto pend(c?)) \in binding \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 5 \} \\
(c? \mapsto pend(c?)) \notin binding \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 4 \} \\""",
r"""fixReuseLocks = ztrue \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 1 \} \\
(fixReuseLocks = zfalse \land (c? \mapsto pend(c?)) \in binding) \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 5 \} \\
(fixReuseLocks = zfalse \land (c? \mapsto pend(c?)) \notin binding) \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 4 \} \\""")
# --- LockReuse op
lock=r"""\begin{schema}{LcCfLockReuse}
\Delta Lifecycle \\
\Xi LcTime \\
\Xi LcRoster \\
\Xi LcKind \\
\Xi LcStarted \\
\Xi LcCorrupt \\
\Xi LcLineage \\
\Xi LcSeen \\
\Xi LcClaim \\
\Xi LcBinding \\
\Xi LcPending \\
\Xi LcUsed \\
\Xi LcSkeleton \\
\Xi LcOpen \\
\Xi LcVerdict \\
\Xi LcSweep \\
\Xi LcMission \\
\Xi LcSealed \\
\Xi LcPurged \\
\Xi LcLeak \\
c? : SESSIONID
\where
(c? \mapsto 1) \in stage \\
c? \in \dom cfD \\
cfM(c?) \in missOpen \\
cfH' = cfH \cup \{ c? \} \\
cfD' = cfD \\
cfM' = cfM \\
cfW' = cfW \\
(c? \mapsto cfD(c?)) \in binding \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 5 \} \\
(c? \mapsto cfD(c?)) \notin binding \implies stage' = stage \oplus \{ c? \mapsto 4 \}
\end{schema}

"""
sub(r"\begin{schema}{LcCfAlloc}",lock+r"\begin{schema}{LcCfAlloc}")
# --- CloseLocked guard
sub(r"\lnot (\exists c : \dom stage @ stage(c) \geq 2 \land cfM(c) = m?)",r"\lnot (\exists c : cfH @ cfM(c) = m?)")
# invariant + wellformed

Lifecycle

\begin{schema}{LcInvReconcileOnExit}""")
sub(r"todo \subseteq skel \\",r"todo \subseteq skel \\"+"\ncfH \\subseteq \\dom stage \\\\")
